column1: # Hungarian (hu) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Hungarian video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product
# UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands use the noun form of the action
# ("Projekt megnyitása…"), messages address the user informally ("te"). Product, format and feature
# names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri, ProRes, LUFS…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (29,97 fps).
# Strings added later show in English until they are translated.
# Terms: track = sáv, sequence = szekvencia, clip = klip, bin = gyűjtő, playhead = lejátszófej,
# In/Out = Be-/Kipont, marker = jelölő, keyframe = kulcskocka, transition = áttűnés, caption =
# felirat, transcript = leirat, workspace = munkaterület, preset = sablon, render = renderelés,
# frame = képkocka, frame hold = állókép, footage = felvétel, nest = beágyazás, subclip = alklip,
# lift / extract = kiemelés / kivonás, ripple = hullám(vágás, -törlés), roll = gördítés, slip =
# csúsztatás, slide = eltolás, razor = penge, opacity = átlátszatlanság, scope = szkóp.
